هذه سيرة علي بن أبي طالب عليه السلام كما: This is the life of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) as the Imami books tell it: Nahj al-Balagha, in which al-Sharif al-Radi gathered his words; al-Irshad by al-Shaykh al-Mufid; al-Kafi; al-Saduq's Amali; Waq'at Siffin; and others. He was born in the House of God, raised in the lap of the Messenger of God, fought at his side, endured patiently after him, ruled with justice, and was martyred in the niche of prayer.
